summary: The registrant, Faeth Therapeutics, Inc., filed an 8-K to disclose an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program, not a special situation. The company entered into a Sales Agreement with TD Securities (USA) LLC to sell up to $150M of common stock from time to time, with a 3.0% agent commission. The filing also reports the automatic conversion of Series B Preferred Stock into common shares. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The ATM program is a routine capital markets activity.
